name: HIGH PINE CUSTOM APPAREL
old_description: Our manual screen printing process combines skilled craftsmanship with lasting quality. Ink is pressed through a fine mesh screen onto each garment, with a separate screen used for every color in the design. We use durable inks and meticulously maintained screens to produce sharp, detailed artwork. Whether it’s a small batch or a large run, every order receives the same care and attention to detail.
about:
High Pine Custom Apparel operates from Standish, Maine, at 320 Ossipee Trail West. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and the founders are not named on the company's website. The business presents itself as a Maine-made custom apparel brand offering a range of decoration services.

The shop provides manual screen printing, embroidery with in-house digitizing (including 3D puff and appliqué options), transfer printing for full-color designs, and graphic design services covering logos and brand development. It also produces stickers and custom apparel. The company describes its screen printing as using durable inks and meticulously maintained screens for sharp artwork, and notes it handles orders from small batches to large runs. Embroidery is offered from a few hats to full workwear runs.

High Pine serves businesses and organizations needing branded apparel and promotional items, with examples including musical acts such as Muscadine Bloodline's Charlie Muncaster wearing High Pine on tour. Its customer base spans companies seeking workwear, brand identity builds, and custom merchandise.

The company emphasizes skilled craftsmanship and consistent attention to detail across all order sizes, highlighting its in-house art capabilities and the durability of its inks and stitching as distinguishing factors.
